verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of the sons of Korah. LORD, you were kind to your land. You made the people of Jacob successful again.
You forgave the sins of your people. You covered all their sin. Selah.
You took back all your anger. You turned away from your burning rage.
God our saviour, bring us back again. Put an end to your anger against us.
Will you be angry with us forever? Will your anger go on for all generations?
Won't you give us new life again, so your people can be glad because of you?
LORD, show us your faithful love. Give us your saving help.
I will listen to what God the LORD says. He promises peace to his people, his faithful ones. But they must not go back to their foolish ways.
His saving help is surely near those who respect him, so that his glory may live in our land.
Faithful love and truth meet together. Goodness and peace kiss each other.
Truth springs up from the earth, and goodness looks down from heaven.
The LORD will give what is good, and our land will produce its harvest.
Goodness goes ahead of him and prepares the way for his steps.
